item.title: DeepWisdom AI Agents Aid Solo Entrepreneurs with Code-Free Product Development
item.description: DeepWisdom, a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) start-up, has launched its Atoms multi-agent application. The platform aims to help solo entrepreneurs develop finished products without writing a single line of code, deploying AI agents to serve in different roles.

item.title: AI and Jobs: Young Workers Most Concerned, Randstad Survey Reveals
item.description: A recent Randstad survey indicates four in five workers anticipate artificial intelligence will affect their daily workplace tasks, with Gen Z among those most concerned as companies increasingly rely on AI chatbots and automation, a survey conducted by Randstad showed on Tuesday.

item.title: Netflix Presents All-Cash Bid for Warner Bros Discovery Assets
item.description: Netflix has switched to an all-cash offer for Warner Bros Discovery’s studio and streaming assets. The all-cash offer of USD 27.75 per share, maintaining the overall USD 82.7 billion valuation, aims to counter Paramount’s rival efforts for the Hollywood company. The Warner Bros board has unanimously supported the new all-cash proposal.

item.title: UK Considers Social Media Ban for Under-16s
item.description: The British government is considering an Australia-style ban on social media for children under 16. Prime Minister Keir Starmer stated children risk being "pulled into a world of endless scrolling, anxiety and comparison." Starmer indicated the government is prepared to take robust action. item.title: Hybrid Robot Inspired by Tumbleweeds Designed for Tough Terrains
item.description: A new study details a hybrid robot that combines the wind-driven mobility of tumbleweeds with active quadcopter control, offering a new paradigm for energy-efficient terrestrial exploration. This innovation addresses the current lack of wind-exploiting systems in terrestrial exploration and the complexity of large, drag-driven robots. The study was published in *Nature Communications*.

item.title: Intel's Turnaround Efforts Highlighted Amid Rising AI Data Centre Chip Demand
item.description: Intel shareholders anticipate improved company results, suggesting a turnaround led by Chief Executive Officer Lip-Bu Tan is progressing. Increased demand for traditional server chips, driven by rapid data centre build-outs, is also contributing to optimism.

item.title: Apple Prepares Siri AI Chatbot Integration
item.description: Apple plans to transform its digital assistant Siri into the company's first artificial intelligence chatbot later this year. The revamp aims to embed the new chatbot deeply into Apple's core operating systems for iPhone, iPad, and Mac devices.
